# jtt config show

Print every setting, never the token.

![jtt config show](gifs/config-show.gif)

```console
$ jtt config show
```

It shows the site, where the settings file and the token are, the working calendar, and per
project the tracked field, its id, the unit of its numbers and the unit reports show it in. ★
marks the default project.
